c74object.name: ear.adm
c74object.digest: Read and write ADM files (BW64 with ADM metadata) alongside the renderers. 'read' loads a file's ADM, reports its rendering items and which file tracks carry them, and 'time', 'start' or 'seek' emit the metadata of the Objects items as mc.ear.objects~ messages with the EAR's interpolation rules (a 'setvalue N ramp' message precedes each block)
c74object.description: Read and write ADM files (BW64 with ADM metadata) alongside the renderers. 'read' loads a file's ADM, reports its rendering items and which file tracks carry them, and 'time', 'start' or 'seek' emit the metadata of the Objects items as mc.ear.objects~ messages with the EAR's interpolation rules (a 'setvalue N ramp' message precedes each block). DirectSpeakers beds and HOA scenes are emitted as mc.ear.direct~ and mc.ear.hoa~ messages when the file is read. For writing, 'record' captures the object messages sent to this object, 'direct ...' and 'hoa ...' take the bed and scene metadata in the mc.ear.direct~ and mc.ear.hoa~ formats (written after the objects' tracks), and 'write' combines the captured metadata with an audio file recorded by mc.sfrecord~ into a BW64 file with ADM metadata.

method.name: anything
method.digest: Captured object metadata: any parameter sent as a message applies to all objects
method.description: Captured object metadata: any parameter sent as a message applies to all objects.

method.name: applyvalues
method.digest: Captured object metadata: 'applyvalues parameter v1 v2 v3 ...' spreads values over the objects
method.description: Captured object metadata: 'applyvalues parameter v1 v2 v3 ...' spreads values over the objects.

method.name: chans
method.digest: Set the chans attribute
method.description: Set the chans attribute. Number of objects captured for writing (one per audio track of the file written).

method.name: clear
method.digest: Discard the captured timeline and reset every object's and bed channel's parameters
method.description: Discard the captured timeline and reset every object's and bed channel's parameters.

method.name: direct
method.digest: Metadata of the bed written after the objects (see the directchans attribute), in the mc.ear.direct~ format: 'direct setvalue N speakerlabel M+030' (N is 1-based; 0 sets all channels), 'direct setvalue N position az el [dist]', azimuth, elevation, distance, cartesian (then position is x y z), x, y, z, bounds, lfe, packformat, 'direct applyvalues parameter v1 v2 ...', 'direct inputlayout 0+5+0' (labels, positions and LFE after a BS.2051 layout, written as a reference to the common definitions when the layout has one), 'direct name symbol' (the bed's audioObject name), or 'direct parameter values' for all channels
method.description: Metadata of the bed written after the objects (see the directchans attribute), in the mc.ear.direct~ format: 'direct setvalue N speakerlabel M+030' (N is 1-based; 0 sets all channels), 'direct setvalue N position az el [dist]', azimuth, elevation, distance, cartesian (then position is x y z), x, y, z, bounds, lfe, packformat, 'direct applyvalues parameter v1 v2 ...', 'direct inputlayout 0+5+0' (labels, positions and LFE after a BS.2051 layout, written as a reference to the common definitions when the layout has one), 'direct name symbol' (the bed's audioObject name), or 'direct parameter values' for all channels. While 'record' runs, a change of a channel's labels, position or bounds is captured as a timed block (such a bed is written with its own channel formats). The 'tracks' message of a reading ear.adm or mc.ear.play~ is ignored, so their direct outlet can be fed to this message.

method.name: directchans
method.digest: Set the directchans attribute
method.description: Set the directchans attribute. Number of DirectSpeakers channels written as a bed on the tracks after the objects (0: no bed); their metadata comes from 'direct' messages.

method.name: dump
method.digest: Report the file, its programmes, rendering items and warnings on the info outlet
method.description: Report the file, its programmes, rendering items and warnings on the info outlet.

method.name: hoa
method.digest: Metadata of the HOA scene written after the bed, in the mc.ear.hoa~ format: 'hoa order N' (the hoaorder attribute; -1 for no scene), 'hoa normalization SN3D|N3D|FuMa' and 'hoa name symbol'
method.description: Metadata of the HOA scene written after the bed, in the mc.ear.hoa~ format: 'hoa order N' (the hoaorder attribute; -1 for no scene), 'hoa normalization SN3D|N3D|FuMa' and 'hoa name symbol'. The 'tracks' message of a reading ear.adm or mc.ear.play~ is ignored, so their hoa outlet can be fed to this message.

method.name: hoanormalization
method.digest: Set the hoanormalization attribute
method.description: Set the hoanormalization attribute. Normalization of the HOA scene written: SN3D, N3D or FuMa. Also set by 'hoa normalization name'.

method.name: hoaorder
method.digest: Set the hoaorder attribute
method.description: Set the hoaorder attribute. Ambisonic order of the HOA scene written on the (order+1)^2 tracks after the bed, in ACN order; -1 for no scene. Also set by 'hoa order N'.

method.name: list
method.digest: Captured object metadata: a list sets the position of all objects
method.description: Captured object metadata: a list sets the position of all objects.

method.name: name
method.digest: Name an object for writing: 'name N symbol' (N is 1-based)
method.description: Name an object for writing: 'name N symbol' (N is 1-based).

method.name: overview
method.digest: Write a waveform overview of the read file into a buffer~ for waveform~: 'overview name [bins per second]' (100 by default)
method.description: Write a waveform overview of the read file into a buffer~ for waveform~: 'overview name [bins per second]' (100 by default). The file is scanned on a thread of its own, then the buffer~ gets one channel per file track and two samples per bin, the lowest then the highest sample of the bin, at a sample rate of twice the bins per second, so waveform~ draws the file's own timeline. 'overview name channels bins bins-per-second' is reported on the info outlet when the buffer~ is written.

method.name: profile
method.digest: Set the profile attribute
method.description: Set the profile attribute. Shape of the ADM written: 'ebu' (BS.2076 as libadm writes it) or 'dolby' (the Dolby Atmos Master ADM Profile: the bed with Dolby's channel formats, labels and Cartesian positions, the objects with Cartesian blocks, the profile's names, ids and timing; what the profile has no place for, such as an HOA scene, is left out with a warning).

method.name: programme
method.digest: Select the audioProgramme to render by index (1-based) when the file has several, and re-read the items
method.description: Select the audioProgramme to render by index (1-based) when the file has several, and re-read the items.

method.name: programmename
method.digest: Set the programmename attribute
method.description: Set the programmename attribute. Name of the audioProgramme written.

method.name: ramp
method.digest: Set the ramp attribute
method.description: Set the ramp attribute. Default interpolation time in milliseconds written for captured changes, as the renderer's ramp attribute; 'setvalue N ramp ms' overrides it per object (a negative value returns to it).

method.name: read
method.digest: Read an ADM (BW64) file: 'read path'
method.description: Read an ADM (BW64) file: 'read path'. Reports the file, its programmes and rendering items on the info outlet, sends the track lists and static metadata to the renderer outlets and emits the object metadata for time 0.

method.name: record
method.digest: Start capturing the object messages sent to this object (setvalue, applyvalues, parameters, lists) and the bed's 'direct' changes, timestamped from now; the current state of every object and bed channel becomes its first block
method.description: Start capturing the object messages sent to this object (setvalue, applyvalues, parameters, lists) and the bed's 'direct' changes, timestamped from now; the current state of every object and bed channel becomes its first block. Stop with 'stop'.

method.name: seek
method.digest: Move the transport to a position in milliseconds ('seek 0' rewinds) and emit the metadata there
method.description: Move the transport to a position in milliseconds ('seek 0' rewinds) and emit the metadata there.

method.name: setvalue
method.digest: Captured object metadata, in the mc.ear.objects~ format: 'setvalue N parameter values...' (N is 1-based; 0 sets all objects)
method.description: Captured object metadata, in the mc.ear.objects~ format: 'setvalue N parameter values...' (N is 1-based; 0 sets all objects). Parameters: azimuth elevation distance x y z cartesian position width height depth gain diffuse channellock channellock_distance divergence divergence_range screenref screenedgelock_h screenedgelock_v, and ramp (the interpolation time written for the next changes of that object; negative returns to the ramp attribute).

method.name: start
method.digest: Start the transport: emits the object metadata at every block boundary from the current position, on Max's scheduler, until the end of the file
method.description: Start the transport: emits the object metadata at every block boundary from the current position, on Max's scheduler, until the end of the file. Send 'start' to mc.sfplay~ at the same time to play the audio.

method.name: stop
method.digest: Stop the transport (and a running capture)
method.description: Stop the transport (and a running capture).

method.name: time
method.digest: Emit the object metadata for a time position in milliseconds ('time 1500'), as the renderer messages for the blocks active at that time
method.description: Emit the object metadata for a time position in milliseconds ('time 1500'), as the renderer messages for the blocks active at that time. Only blocks that changed since the last emission are sent.

method.name: write
method.digest: Write a BW64 file with the captured metadata as ADM: 'write out.wav in.wav' copies the audio of in.wav (recorded with mc.sfrecord~ for example: one track per object, then the bed's channels, then the HOA components) into out.wav with the chna and axml chunks
method.description: Write a BW64 file with the captured metadata as ADM: 'write out.wav in.wav' copies the audio of in.wav (recorded with mc.sfrecord~ for example: one track per object, then the bed's channels, then the HOA components) into out.wav with the chna and axml chunks. Reports 'written path tracks frames'.

method.name: writexml
method.digest: Write the captured metadata as an ADM XML file: 'writexml out.xml [length seconds]' (for inspection, or for tools that take the metadata separately)
method.description: Write the captured metadata as an ADM XML file: 'writexml out.xml [length seconds]' (for inspection, or for tools that take the metadata separately).

attribute.name: chans
attribute.digest: Number of objects captured for writing (one per audio track of the file written)
attribute.description: Number of objects captured for writing (one per audio track of the file written). Default: 16.

attribute.name: directchans
attribute.digest: Number of DirectSpeakers channels written as a bed on the tracks after the objects (0: no bed); their metadata comes from 'direct' messages
attribute.description: Number of DirectSpeakers channels written as a bed on the tracks after the objects (0: no bed); their metadata comes from 'direct' messages. Default: 0.

attribute.name: hoanormalization
attribute.digest: Normalization of the HOA scene written: SN3D, N3D or FuMa
attribute.description: Normalization of the HOA scene written: SN3D, N3D or FuMa. Also set by 'hoa normalization name'. Default: SN3D.

attribute.name: hoaorder
attribute.digest: Ambisonic order of the HOA scene written on the (order+1)^2 tracks after the bed, in ACN order; -1 for no scene
attribute.description: Ambisonic order of the HOA scene written on the (order+1)^2 tracks after the bed, in ACN order; -1 for no scene. Also set by 'hoa order N'. Default: -1.

attribute.name: profile
attribute.digest: Shape of the ADM written: 'ebu' (BS.2076 as libadm writes it) or 'dolby' (the Dolby Atmos Master ADM Profile: the bed with Dolby's channel formats, labels and Cartesian positions, the objects with Cartesian blocks, the profile's names, ids and timing; what the profile has no place for, such as an HOA scene, is left out with a warning)
attribute.description: Shape of the ADM written: 'ebu' (BS.2076 as libadm writes it) or 'dolby' (the Dolby Atmos Master ADM Profile: the bed with Dolby's channel formats, labels and Cartesian positions, the objects with Cartesian blocks, the profile's names, ids and timing; what the profile has no place for, such as an HOA scene, is left out with a warning). Default: ebu.

attribute.name: programmename
attribute.description: Name of the audioProgramme written. Default: libear-max.

attribute.name: ramp
attribute.digest: Default interpolation time in milliseconds written for captured changes, as the renderer's ramp attribute; 'setvalue N ramp ms' overrides it per object (a negative value returns to it)
attribute.description: Default interpolation time in milliseconds written for captured changes, as the renderer's ramp attribute; 'setvalue N ramp ms' overrides it per object (a negative value returns to it). Default: 10.
